messages:
emma_cs: FYI incoming from Acme finance — dashboard shows 42,187 tokens for Feb but invoice shows 54,391 and their plan auto-upgraded to P2. They say it happened at month-end cutoff. Can someone triage?

devon_billing: thanks. can you paste the customer_id and invoice id? also did they attach the CSV export?

emma_cs: customer_id: acct-ACME-9832, invoice: INV-2025-02-ACME-78. They attached the CSV (screenshot) and claimed there are ~12k phantom tokens between dashboard and invoice.

matt_infra: pinging infra. initial hypothesis: duplicate ingestion or double-run of metering job around cutoff. Any known reruns overnight?

billing-bot: Metering pipeline runs: daily-meter-2025-02-28 (completed), daily-meter-2025-02-28-retry (completed, triggered by monitoring alert at 00:12 UTC), reconciliation-2025-02-28 (started 01:05 UTC).

devon_billing: oh interesting — we had that retry. do we have dedupe safeguards for retry runs?

matt_infra: yes we do normally, but there was a schema bump in prod yesterday (seq_batch_id added) that the dedupe lambda didn't handle for older opaque events. looking at logs now. snippet:```INFO 2025-02-28T00:12:05Z metering-retry: ingest batch_id=null, seq_batch_id=2457, fallback=true```

sree_eng: if fallback=true then dedupe path may have skipped. can you grep for acct-ACME-9832 around 00:00-02:00 UTC?

matt_infra: grep results: acct-ACME-9832 entries: 00:00:31 4,432 tokens; 00:45:01 6,120 tokens; 00:12:12 6,125 tokens (retry). Looks like same 6,120/6,125 duplication window. combined sum adds ~12,245 extra.

emma_cs: that matches what Acme reported (they had ~12k variance). good catch.

devon_billing: can we confidently attribute invoice delta to the retry duplication? need audit trail to justify credit.

matt_infra: yes — pipeline trace shows both runs forwarded same event_ids for that account because seq_batch_id was ignored. I'm preparing a compact report with event_ids and ingestion ids.

sree_eng: mitigation: patch dedupe lambda to prefer seq_batch_id when present and reject fallback dupes. I'll open PR and do canary. Also we should remove the duplicate tokens from billing ledger for affected customers before next invoice.

devon_billing: action items: 1) provide customer-facing explanation and provisional credit for 12,204 tokens (approx). 2) run ledger correction job for acct-ACME-9832 for 2025-02-28 window. 3) follow-up postmortem in eng-releases.

emma_cs: I told Acme we'd investigate and may issue credit. they asked for ETA — can we give a window?

matt_infra: ledger-correct job queued, estimate 2 hours to verify and apply. will mark correction id CORR-20250228-ACME-1 and send full audit (event ids + tx ids).

devon_billing: I'll draft the customer note once matt posts audit. Suggest wording: brief root cause, exact token count, credit line on next invoice or immediate one-time credit — ask customer preference.

sree_eng: PR opened: github.com/redwood/meters/pull/412 — patch adds seq_batch_id dedupe and unit tests for retry path. Planning canary to 10% traffic tonight.

billing-bot: Ledger correction completed: CORR-20250228-ACME-1 applied by matt_infra at 1990012600. delta_tokens: -12204. Credit issued: yes (one-time on invoice INV-2025-02-ACME-78).

emma_cs: forwarded credit confirmation to Acme and closed their support case. they appreciated the quick turnaround.

devon_billing: marking this as resolved but assigning postmortem to eng-releases. please include timeline and why schema bump didn't break tests.

sree_eng: will write postmortem and mitigation plan. TL;DR: retry run + schema bump -> dedupe bypass -> duplicate token ingestion around UTC midnight.

matt_infra: note for ops: add an automated alert when retry run count > 0 within 2 hours of monthly cutoff. avoided bigger spike this month.

emma_cs: thanks all :thumbsup:
